title: Cookie Bar with Chocolate, Nuts and Graham Crackers

content.title: About
content.content: The cookie bar combines crunchy graham crackers, rich milk chocolate, and a blend of toasted nuts. It is designed for fans of sweet‑nutty flavors, offering a balanced texture: soft inside with a crisp exterior.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Graham crackers originated in the United States in the late 19th century and are a base for many desserts.
The chocolate coating is thin enough to keep the nuts crunchy.
The nut mix usually includes walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds, boosting the content of healthy fats.
The bar is packaged in single‑serve portions, making it popular for office snacks.
When stored properly, the product stays fresh for up to 6 months.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Chocolate provides flavonoids that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Nuts supply monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Graham crackers and nuts are high in fiber, promoting normal digestion.

items.title: Energy sustaining
items.content: The combination of carbs from the crackers and fats from the nuts offers lasting satiety and energy.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The bar provides magnesium, iron, vitamin E and B‑complex vitamins important for metabolic processes.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: The product contains nuts, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The bar is calorie‑dense, so moderate portion sizes are recommended.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The chocolate layer adds sugar, which may be a concern for people with diabetes or low‑sugar diets.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Chocolate contains a small amount of caffeine, which should be considered by caffeine‑sensitive persons.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bar as a standalone snack, break it into pieces and add to yogurt, ice cream or a salad. It can be lightly warmed in the microwave to melt the chocolate for a gooier texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bar in an airtight package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer storage, refrigerate to prevent the chocolate from blooming.
